title: Lo baazu e shabbir
body:
qaimon mein bapa ahle haram ki ye buka hai
lo baazu e shabbir bhi marne ko chala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
rote huwe kehti hai yehi zainab e dilgeer
tum chal diye haafiz mere parde ka khuda hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
darya se zara mashk ko bhar lao ay bhai
bachon ne kayi roz se pani na piya hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun mashk o alam le ke rawana hua ghazi
jis tarha koi sher taraayi ko chala hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek naize se abbas ne faujon ko bhagaya
darya ko alamdaar ne qabze mein liya hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
talwaar chali kat gaye baazu e alamdar
ek teere sitam mashk e sakina pe laga hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab mashk se guzra to laga seene pe wo teer
ab qaimon mein kiya jaayein ke dil toot chuka hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab laasha e abbas pe pahunche shahe wala
dekha ke jawan sher hai dam tod raha hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi ne kaha laasha mera leke na jaayein
sharminda sakina se bahot uska chacha hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ne dam tod diya zaanu e sheh par
darya ki har ek mauj mein matam ki sada hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi ki shahadat jo hui majid o mukhtar
zainab ki aseeri ka ye aaghaaz hua hai
qaimon mein bapa...
author: Majid Raza Abidi
